title: Validate priority blueberry trait claims under comparable, method-stating protocols before ranking programmes
rationale: Current public soluble-solids and shelf-life figures mix owner claims, conflicting values and an independent trial covering different varieties. Select the highest-decision-value candidate varieties, define comparable maturity, storage and measurement conditions, and use the results to confirm or revise the public working view. Until then, retain provenance labels and avoid programme-level performance rankings.
